ARC-Managed ScrollLayer Handle (Hierarchy-Aware)

Managed wrapper for ScrollLayer that tracks child layers added to it and prevents double-destroy when parent scroll layer is destroyed.

Imports

../ffi, ../ffi/managed, scroll_layer, layer_managed
